evidence.quote:
No blocking
call, and no lost work

observations.why: Two negated clauses set in deliberate contrast within one frame — what the contract forbids paired with what it guarantees — a matched opposition crystallizing the design rule.

evidence.quote:
the agent either polls the run or
gets the reaction piggybacked on a later call

observations.why: Two matched alternatives laid out in parallel grammatical structure — 'polls the run' / 'gets the reaction' — performing a disjunction as balanced clauses.
